prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent PNG game prop sprite for a Chinese dark fantasy reincarnation courtyard, displayed around 92 x 68 pixels.

Primary request: ONE isolated squat CLOSED reliquary storage chest used by reincarnators. Produce only the chest cutout, not a scene. Match a grounded painterly Chinese temple courtyard visual language: charcoal black-brown surfaces, restrained antique old-gold details, dusty weathering, soft warm upper-left lighting, and deep brown-black shadows. The courtyard has monumental dark stone pillars and subtle lotus and cloud carvings; echo that visual language only in the chest's sparse carving.

Subject and materials: broad low chest of very dark weathered carved wood, aged bronze corner fittings and an antique old-gold central latch. Small restrained Chinese cloud and lotus motifs, low-relief and organic, with slight dusty verdigris in seams. Natural uneven wear and painted material texture. A shut shallow lid, legible dark front panel, a modest central metal latch; no lock inscription.

Composition: entire object centered on a genuinely transparent background. Full object with approximately 5 percent transparent margin on every side. Chest width to height about 92:68. 2.5D FRONT view with only a slight three-quarter turn showing a narrow right side and shallow lid top. Camera close to eye level, not high isometric or top-down. Broad flat low base, center-bottom anchor. Readable bold silhouette at 92 x 68 pixels; keep carved detail sparse. No large extra footprint.

Style: polished hand-painted game sprite with organic contour, grounded material, depth and soft painterly shading consistent with an elaborate black stone and old-gold Chinese sanctuary. Avoid flat geometric CSS blocks, cartoon outlines, overly smooth plastic and shiny product photography.

Constraints: ONE closed chest only. Preserve real alpha transparency all around. No environment, background, floor, platform, floor plane, pedestal, stage, cast shadow outside the object, people, text, writing, UI, label, frame, watermark, orange wooden crate, treasure spill, open lid, neon, floating crystals or magical glow. No other objects.
